patch.summary:
Choose HiBob only if your buying job matches “Culture-forward mid-market HRIS (Bob Core + modules) — custom PEPM quote; no published sea” rather than Oracle Cloud HCM's shape. Choose Oracle Cloud HCM only if your buying job matches “Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM — modular enterprise suite (Global HR, payroll, talent, WFM); cust” rather than HiBob's shape. Workflow advantage: HiBob leans core-hris; Oracle Cloud HCM leans enterprise-hcm. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Company-size focus: HiBob (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Oracle Cloud HCM (enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: HiBob-leaning core-hris vs Oracle Cloud HCM-leaning enterprise-hcm.
